{{Exclusive}} {{For|other uses of [[Monster (Disambiguation)|Monster]]}} {{UnitInfobox |image1 = MonsterNotMash.png |source = N/A |type = Beast (& Humanoid) |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]400,000 |damage_type = Collision
Single |ranged_damage = [[File:Melee.png|20px|Damage]]1,500 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.625 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]10 |speed = 1.2 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Monster''' is currently an exclusive unit only available via admin commands and has no known tower associated with it. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. Whenever there is an enemy in its range, the '''Monster''' will stop moving and attack the enemy. ==Appearance== The '''Monster''' has glowing orange lava like skin with dark blue granite as its torso and legs. It features a distinct black wolf mask made of metal, skulls as shoulder pads, and chains wrapped around its body. There are rusty spikes around the back of its neck and upper torso. It emits grey smoke around its body. There is also a trainer behind the '''Monster''', holding it captive with chains. It has tan skin, dark blue torso, dark blue pants, and a black welding mask. It also has a sweating effect on its head. ==Trivia== *The '''Monster''' has the highest health for a unit in the game. *The '''Monster''' was originally planned to be added in the [[Frost Invasion Event]], but was cancelled because it was not completed by the time the event was released. **It has been revamped as the [[Molten Monster]] for the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. *The '''Monster''' was sent out on the path by the devs during the admin abuse part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Monster''' added as a commands only unit. *'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]] **Firerate decreased due to the [[Firerate Bug]] being made less severe. ***Firerate decreased from 0.63 to 0.625. *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Monster's''' range can be increased by the [[DJ Booth]]. *'''21 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.3]] **{{Bug}} '''Monster''' can be damaged by towers that use hitboxes. *'''22 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.3]]b **{{Bugfix}} '''Monster''' can no longer be damaged by towers that use hitboxes. *'''5 August 2022''' - [[v1.3.1]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Monster's''' range can no longer be increased by the [[DJ Booth]]. *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **Firerate increased from 0.625 to 0.63 due to [[Firerate Bug]] getting more severe for units. *'''9 January 2023''' - [[v1.6.0]]f **Firerate decreased from 0.63 to 0.625 due to [[Firerate Bug]] getting less severe for units. *'''12 November 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]l **{{Bug}} '''Monster''' starts going backwards after reaching the entrance, dying at the exit. *'''1 December 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]b **{{Bugfix}} '''Monster''' no longer goes backwards after reaching the entrance, now disappears instead. *'''10 February 2024''' - [[v1.13.0]] **'''Monster''' now has hidden detection. }} {{TowerNavBox}}
